videos.title: Nest.js Tutorial for Beginners
videos.description: This video introduces NestJS, contrasting it with Node.js and Express, and outlines its basic structure. It demonstrates creating a REST API, covering module setup, controllers, and providers within a NestJS application.

videos.title: Nest.js Crash Course #1 - Introduction & Setup
videos.description: This video introduces Nest.js, a Node.js framework for server-side applications. It covers setting up a new project and begins building an API, demonstrating the foundational steps for developing with Nest.js.

videos.title: The Right way to write Nest.js & Typescript clean-code - SOLID
videos.description: This video explains the five SOLID principles for writing clean code: Single Responsibility, Open-Closed, Liskov Substitution, Interface Segregation, and Dependency Inversion. It demonstrates their application within Nest.js and TypeScript.

videos.title: Nest.js Microservices Tutorial in 20 Minutes
videos.description: This tutorial demonstrates creating a Nest.js project. It covers building microservices and an API Gateway, illustrating how these components integrate within a Nest.js architecture.

videos.title: NestJS Tutorial #1
videos.description: This video introduces NestJS, a framework inspired by Angular, covering its core principles like Dependency Injection. It explains key concepts such as the Controller, Service, and Repository patterns, emphasizes test integration, and discusses its microservice architecture.

videos.title: Every NestJS Concept Explained in 9 Minutes
videos.description: This video explains fundamental NestJS concepts, including applications, modules, decorators, controllers, providers, middleware, guards, interceptors, pipes, and filters, to build a strong understanding of NestJS application development.

videos.title: NestJS tutorial for Beginners 1 - Getting Started + Creating First Nest.JS Application
videos.description: This video provides a beginner's guide to NestJS, a Node.js framework. It covers installing the NestJS CLI and developing a foundational NestJS application, focusing on server-side development for creating efficient and scalable applications.

videos.title: Nest.js | Events & Task Scheduling Tutorial
videos.description: This video explores decoupling application functionality using Nest.js. It covers implementing event-driven architecture and utilizing task scheduling for backend services, focusing on cleaner code and improved performance.

videos.title: Nest.js File Upload to AWS S3 + Rate Limiting
videos.description: This video demonstrates configuring NestJS for file uploads to AWS S3 using the AWS Node.js SDK. It covers best practices for implementing this functionality, including rate limiting to manage request volume efficiently.

videos.title: Nest.js + Kafka Tutorial With KafkaJS in 15 Minutes
videos.description: This video demonstrates integrating KafkaJS with Nest.js to enable message production and consumption with a local Kafka server. It covers essential steps for connecting the two frameworks.

videos.title: NestJS Tutorial #9 - Connecting to MySQL using TypeORM
videos.description: This video demonstrates connecting a NestJS application to a MySQL database using TypeORM. It covers configuration steps and practical examples for integrating object-relational mapping with a relational database within the NestJS framework.

videos.title: NestJS Websockets Tutorial #2 - Connect to Websocket Server from another Nest API
videos.description: This video demonstrates connecting a NestJS backend API to a NestJS WebSocket server. It covers essential steps for establishing WebSocket communication between two NestJS applications.

videos.title: NestJS Tutorial #13 - Sessions
videos.description: This tutorial covers implementing sessions in NestJS applications. It explains configuring session middleware, typically using Express sessions, and demonstrates how to store and retrieve data associated with user sessions.

videos.description: This video demonstrates how to create professional-grade documentation for NestJS API endpoints, detailing methods for generating clear and comprehensive API references.
